title: Where the flaw is born: requirement, design or implementation

videos.script: A clinic's patient portal lets people cancel a booking up to a day before. Somebody wrote it carefully. It checks that you are signed in. It checks that the booking exists. It checks the clock. {{checks}} And any patient can cancel anybody's booking. {{flaw}} Nobody wrote a bug there. The requirement never said whose booking. The code did exactly what it was asked. {{requirement}} Flaws are born in three places: the requirement, the design and the code. Each one is cheapest to catch where it was born. {{three}} This course is about the third place, the code, in one language: Python, with Flask. {{language}} Every lesson follows the same loop. Write a test that says what must be refused. Watch it fail. Fix the code. Watch it pass. {{loop}} Today you build your lab, on your own computer, and run that loop once, on the cancel button. {{lab}}
